corrections.reason: Weight is the pull of gravity, a non-contact force. A kid can't match weight to its downward direction without knowing gravity is a force, which is taught in g3-sci-force-types. g3-sci-force-effects does not depend on that skill, so it is a missing prerequisite rather than a redundant one.

The skill defines weight as how hard gravity pulls on something. Telling mass and weight apart requires knowing that gravity is a force, which is taught in g3-sci-force-types. That prerequisite is not covered by g5-sci-matter-def, so it is missing.

output.notes: Reviewed all 34 proposed Grade 6 skills (B, C, D, E strands). Every prerequisite id exists, none points to a later grade or to the skill itself, and none is redundant with another listed prerequisite. Two skills, g6-sci-four-forces and g6-sci-mass-weight, are missing g3-sci-force-types, the gravity/non-contact force concept that weight depends on. Other possible gaps were judged too weak to correct, for example whether g6-sci-biodiversity-benefits needs g3-sci-plant-uses for the medicine example. Titles and descriptions read clearly for a kid hearing them aloud.
